items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: He's all the way down by Joe Propp, Baldwin.

ctx.x: I'll run into him sometime, I guess, for the end of the day, but, you know, I don't recognize him.
No. He's all the way down by Joe Propp, Baldwin.

Joe Propp? Joe Propp was there. Oh. Joe Propp. Mm-hmm. Of course, he lives upstairs. Mm-hmm. In the boardroom of town. Uh, what about, uh, Sing played there for a while, didn't he? With somebody. I'm trying to remember who he was with.
